candidate.blueprint_locator: Management of Care — leadership, staff development, and organizational resource management
candidate.educational_objective: Explain how succession planning supports continuity and development of the nursing leadership pipeline.

options.A: Develop leadership bench strength and prepare qualified nurses for future leadership roles.
options.B: Reserve leadership development only for organizations operating for profit.
options.C: Discourage internal professional growth so leadership roles remain externally recruited.
options.D: Guarantee that external recruitment will never be needed.

candidate.rationale: AONL's current Nurse Leadership Workforce Compendium recommends assessing leadership bench strength and making succession planning a core leadership competency. Succession planning supports a pipeline of nurses prepared for future leadership roles; it does not eliminate all external recruitment. A is correct.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Nurse leaders should assess leadership bench strength and make succession planning integral to leadership development and organizational strategy.
candidate.source_document_title: Strengthening Nurse Leadership — Nurse Leadership Workforce Compendium 2.0
